title: group_timeline_entries merge condition never compares kinds despite the comment claiming "same kind + same at"
detail: The condition checks send-kind-ness twice plus `at` equality — never `entry.kind == first_kind(batch)`. A co_nudge sharing `at` with an invitation batch would merge into the invitation line and lose its label and skip reason.
recommended_fix: Add `first_kind(batch) == entry.kind` to the merge condition so only same-kind batches merge, or amend the comment to state the weaker contract.
